lines: The podcast discusses how China is pursuing a 'full-stack' industrial strategy to achieve technological self-reliance and bypass Western export controls.
The hosts note that Beijing's 'new quality productive forces' mandate prioritizes long-term high-tech sovereignty over short-term consumer stimulus or market efficiency.

The episode highlights how Huawei is attempting to overcome lithography bottlenecks by combining lower-performance chips into high-capacity 'super pods' and engaging in deep hardware-software co-design.

The analysis suggests that while U.S. export controls have catalyzed China's push to replicate the entire semiconductor supply chain domestically, Chinese AI firms still face a trade-off between keeping pace with the global frontier and using local hardware.
title: How AI Is Forcing China to Reshape Industrial Policy
